source: Asked to stabilise an internal support agent after its pilot. Using C#/.NET, split Azure OpenAI calls from tool execution, added per-tool allow-lists, bounded retries and runbook retrieval from Qdrant. Released to internal operations in production; it was not customer-facing. Pair-programmed with three engineers and personally reviewed tool-permission edge cases. Ticket reduction and answer accuracy have not been measured.
